title: 615. Maximum Depth of N-ary Tree

examples.explanation: The lone root is itself the longest path.

hints: Split the bracket string on commas; null tokens mark the end of each node's child group.
Rebuild the tree with a queue: each group after a null belongs to the next queued node.
Depth is one plus the deepest child subtree (a leaf contributes 1); a breadth-first level count works too.
